items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-11-17
items.q: Me and Janice received. We said we wasn't going to change.

ctx.x: And when did he change the banjo?

And when did you change the banjo? Let me see. I must have stayed on guitar about five years. And then they, not that long, about two years. And then they come out with the banjo. And I didn't want to change. Me and Janice received. We said we wasn't going to change. And that was the only man I had to meet to see who was the best. And when I did meet him, we played, couldn't tell him who was the best. They said we played the same way, same style. He's back over there now, up in the North, somewhere. Los Angeles,…
